title: Work of a local conditional step
statement: Let $D$ be a finite label set, let $	ext{problem}$ be a constraint satisfaction instance with variables $V$, and let $v\in V$. The work of the local conditional step at $v$ is $|D|$ times the sum of the local table work over all constraints affected by $v$.
hypotheses_covered: The variable type $V$ has decidable equality
